    a.extend([
        poly("prosecutor-shoulders", [(48, 445), (91, 318), (183, 318), (234, 445)], "crimson", "medium", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=7, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        oval("prosecutor-head", 139, 292, 53, 64, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        poly("prosecutor-hair", [(88, 290), (85, 264), (118, 223), (162, 231), (188, 267), (180, 283), (160, 249), (135, 266), (115, 250)], "graphite", "dense", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=2, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        box("prosecutor-tie", 130, 350, 15, 77, "magenta", "dense", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=2, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        poly("defense-jacket", [(718, 445), (750, 314), (851, 314), (918, 445)], "cyan", "dense", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=7, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        oval("defense-head", 805, 290, 52, 65, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        poly("defense-hair", [(754, 271), (763, 224), (827, 221), (857, 269), (840, 245), (801, 239), (785, 255)], "graphite", "medium", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=2, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        box("defense-glasses-left", 760, 279, 38, 17, "graphite", "none", stroke_width=3, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        box("defense-glasses-right", 808, 279, 39, 17, "graphite", "none", stroke_width=3, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        # Judge center and desk: distinct inks and dot density, not a full-frame filter.
        poly("judge-body", [(380, 420), (408, 267), (538, 267), (584, 420)], "graphite", "medium", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=8),
        oval("judge-head", 475, 256, 63, 72, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6),
        poly("judge-hair", [(415, 236), (421, 186), (450, 175), (483, 182), (518, 178), (534, 215), (524, 223), (496, 203), (468, 205), (451, 199)], "paper", "dense", dot_color="amber", stroke_width=4),
        box("bench-front", 285, 390, 388, 90, "violet", "dense", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=8),
        poly("bench-trim", [(284, 392), (674, 392), (688, 405), (275, 405)], "yellow", "open", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=4),
        oval("bench-seal", 479, 444, 36, 27, "yellow", "medium", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=4),
        label("bench-mark", 461, 452, "NC", 20, "graphite"),
    ])
    # Caption tape and labels stay on top with undithered typography.
    a.extend([
        box("subtitle-strip", 32, 485, 896, 41, "paper", "open", dot_color="yellow", stroke_width=4),
        label("top-title", 65, 89, "NERD COURT", 63, "graphite"),

            label("impact-word", 315 + flick, 278, "OBJECTION!", 58, "graphite"),
            poly("impact-speed-one", [(0, 188), (232, 241), (0, 216)], "paper", "dense", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=0),
            poly("impact-speed-two", [(W, 221), (720, 251), (W, 255)], "cyan", "impact", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=0),
        ])
    return s


def synthesize_audio(path: Path, seconds: int) -> None:
    """Original simple mechanical gavel stings; no samples or music licenses."""
    rate = 22050
    pulses = (0.65, 2.13, 3.25, 4.2)
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as f:
        f.setnchannels(1)
        f.setsampwidth(2)
        f.setframerate(rate)
        block = bytearray()
        for i in range(seconds * rate):
            t = i / rate
            value = 0.0
            for at in pulses:
                dt = t - at
                if 0 <= dt < .27:
                    value += (math.sin(2 * math.pi * (128 + 45 * dt) * dt)
                              + .30 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 370 * dt)) * math.exp(-dt * 24)
            block.extend(struct.pack("<h", max(-32767, min(32767, int(value * 12500)))))
        f.writeframes(block)


def create_demo(out_dir: Path, *, seconds: int = DURATION, fps: int = FPS) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    try:
        import cairosvg
    except ImportError as err:
        raise RuntimeError("Demo needs CairoSVG: pip install cairosvg") from err
    if not shutil.which("ffmpeg"):
        raise RuntimeError("Demo needs ffmpeg in PATH")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frame_count = seconds * fps
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nerd-court-ben-day-") as scratch:
        scratch_dir = Path(scratch)
        for i in range(frame_count):
            svg = render_svg(frame_scene(i, fps), frame=i)
            cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=svg.encode("utf-8"),
                             write_to=str(scratch_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png"))
            if i in (0, int(1.2 * fps), int(3.5 * fps)):
                (out_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.svg").write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
                shutil.copy(scratch_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png", out_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png")
        wav = scratch_dir / "original-stings.wav"
        synthesize_audio(wav, seconds)
        video = out_dir / "nerd-court-benday-proof.mp4"
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
               "-framerate", str(fps), "-i", str(scratch_dir / "frame_%04d.png"),
               "-i", str(wav), "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "18", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
               "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k", "-movflags", "+faststart",
               "-t", str(seconds), str(video)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    return video, out_dir / f"frame_{int(3.5 * fps):04d}.png"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/mnt/data/ben_day_proof", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--seconds", default=DURATION, type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--fps", default=FPS, type=int)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.seconds <= 15 or not 5 <= args.fps <= 30:
        ap.error("demo accepts 1–15 seconds and 5–30 fps")
    video, frame = create_demo(args.out, seconds=args.seconds, fps=args.fps)
    print(f"Rendered video {video} and preview {frame}")

[1166] assistant (text, 692 chars)
And I found something useful in the existing code: **Nerd Court already has Ben-Day dot effects.** Both `SpiderVerseEffects.swift` and `CinematicEngine.swift` generate dot patterns, but currently treat them as temporary effects rather than the show's underlying rendering style.

That's the upgrade: **Ben-Day dots become part of the visual system itself.** Courtroom shadows, skin shading, costumes, depth, camera movement, and those gloriously absurd finishers should all obey the same comic-print rules. Dialogue and captions remain readable; the dots enhance the artwork rather than swallowing it.

The original effects give us a starting point, so there's no reason to throw them away.

"""Deterministic, layer-clipped Ben-Day SVG print stage for Nerd Court.

Ben-Day flat-tint screens contain equal-sized dots; visual density changes by
spacing them, rather than resizing every dot to match pixel luminance. This
module draws material-aware screens, not a disposable whole-frame overlay.

The output is ordinary SVG, which can be rasterized or consumed as a media
asset by a separate video encoder. No Kinetograph/SpriteKit connection is
claimed by this package.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from html import escape
from typing import Any, Mapping


class BenDayError(ValueError):
    """Invalid or unsafe scene specification."""


PALETTE = {
    "paper": "#F5ECDD",
    "graphite": "#17131F",
    "violet": "#34204F",
    "magenta": "#F14693",
    "cyan": "#48D3DF",
    "yellow": "#F5CC50",
    "crimson": "#DB3954",
    "amber": "#C69E5D",
    "slate": "#607A9D",
}

# These screens use the *same physical dot radius* at different pitches.
DOT_SCREENS = {"open": 24.0, "medium": 15.0, "dense": 10.0, "impact": 7.5}
DOT_RADIUS = 2.6
# Channel angles keep overlapped screens from all landing on one grid.
INK_ANGLES = {"cyan": 15, "magenta": 75, "yellow": 0, "graphite": 45,
              "crimson": 45, "amber": 0, "slate": 15, "violet": 75, "paper": 0}
_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$")
_HEX = re.compile(r"^#[a-fA-F0-9]{6}$")
_SVG_PATH = re.compile(r"^[MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz0-9,.\s+\-eE]+$")


def _num(value: Any, field: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        raise BenDayError(f"{field} must be numeric")
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError) as exc:
        raise BenDayError(f"{field} must be numeric") from exc
    if not math.isfinite(v) or abs(v) > 10000 or (positive and v <= 0):
        raise BenDayError(f"{field} outside permitted range")
    return f"{v:g}"


def _color(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str) and value in PALETTE:
        return PALETTE[value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and _HEX.fullmatch(value):
        return value.upper()
    raise BenDayError("Color must be a palette name or six-digit hex value")


def _pair(value: Any, name: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or len(value) != 2:
        raise BenDayError(f"{name} must be a two-number array")
    return float(_num(value[0], name)), float(_num(value[1], name))


def _shape(layer: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Return safe SVG shape tag plus sanitized geometric attributes."""
    kind = layer["type"]
    attrs: dict[str, str]
    if kind == "rect":
        attrs = {k: _num(layer.get(k), k, positive=k in ("width", "height"))
                 for k in ("x", "y", "width", "height")}
    elif kind == "circle":
        attrs = {k: _num(layer.get(k), k, positive=k == "r")
                 for k in ("cx", "cy", "r")}
    elif kind == "ellipse":
        attrs = {k: _num(layer.get(k), k, positive=k in ("rx", "ry"))
                 for k in ("cx", "cy", "rx", "ry")}
    elif kind == "path":
        d = layer.get("d")
        if not isinstance(d, str) or not d or len(d) > 12000 or not _SVG_PATH.fullmatch(d):
            raise BenDayError("Invalid SVG path data")
        attrs = {"d": d}
    elif kind == "polygon":
        points = layer.get("points")
        if not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) < 3 or len(points) > 500:
            raise BenDayError("polygon requires 3–500 vertices")
        coords = [_pair(p, "polygon point") for p in points]
        attrs = {"points": " ".join(f"{x:g},{y:g}" for x, y in coords)}
    else:
        raise BenDayError(f"Unsupported painted shape type: {kind!r}")
    return kind, " ".join(f'{k}="{escape(v, quote=True)}"' for k, v in attrs.items())


def render_svg(scene: Mapping[str, Any], *, frame: int = 0) -> str:
    """Render one fully specified frame as a deterministic Ben-Day SVG.

    scene: {width,height,layers:[shape|text], registration:[x,y]}
    Shapes are solid flat inks with their own uniform-dot tint screens;
    labels/text are rendered *after* printed surfaces and never dithered.

    The caller controls geometry, color choices, camera translation, and
    character poses. Dots default to 'medium', not 'none', for every shape.
    Dots are object-locked by default, screen-locked when anchor='screen'.
    """
    if not isinstance(scene, Mapping):
        raise BenDayError("scene must be a mapping")
    if isinstance(frame, bool) or not isinstance(frame, int) or frame < 0 or frame > 10**8:
        raise BenDayError("frame must be a nonnegative integer")
    width = _num(scene.get("width"), "width", positive=True)
    height = _num(scene.get("height"), "height", positive=True)
    layers = scene.get("layers")
    if not isinstance(layers, list) or len(layers) > 512:
        raise BenDayError("layers must be an array of at most 512 objects")
    register_x, register_y = _pair(scene.get("registration", [0, 0]), "registration")
    paper = _color(scene.get("paper", "paper"))
    defs: list[str] = []
    art: list[str] = []
    text_art: list[str] = []
    seen_ids: set[str] = set()

    for layer in layers:
        if not isinstance(layer, Mapping):
            raise BenDayError("each layer must be an object")
        ident = layer.get("id")
        if not isinstance(ident, str) or not _ID.fullmatch(ident) or ident in seen_ids:
            raise BenDayError("layer id must be unique, short and safe")
        seen_ids.add(ident)
        tx, ty = _pair(layer.get("translate", [0, 0]), "translate")
        trans = f'translate({tx:g} {ty:g})'
        fill = _color(layer.get("fill", "paper"))
        opacity = _num(layer.get("opacity", 1), "opacity")
        if not 0 <= float(opacity) <= 1:
            raise BenDayError("opacity outside [0,1]")
        if layer.get("type") == "text":
            # Captions, nameplates, verdicts and subtitles never receive dot masks.
            x, y = (_num(layer.get(k), k) for k in ("x", "y"))
            size = _num(layer.get("font_size", 20), "font_size", positive=True)
            weight = "700" if layer.get("bold", True) else "400"
            if not isinstance(layer.get("text"), str) or len(layer["text"]) > 1500:
                raise BenDayError("text must be a string of at most 1500 characters")
            text_art.append(f'<g transform="{trans}" opacity="{opacity}"><text id="{ident}" '
                            f'x="{x}" y="{y}" fill="{fill}" font-size="{size}" '
                            f'font-family="DejaVu Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="{weight}">'
                            f'{escape(layer["text"])}</text></g>')
            continue

        tag, geom = _shape(layer)
        dots = layer.get("dots", "medium")
        if dots not in (*DOT_SCREENS.keys(), "none"):
            raise BenDayError("unknown Ben-Day dot screen")
        ink = _color(layer.get("stroke", "graphite"))
        outline = _num(layer.get("stroke_width", 2.5), "stroke_width")
        if float(outline) < 0:
            raise BenDayError("stroke_width must not be negative")
        body = [f'<{tag} {geom} fill="{fill}"/>']
        if dots != "none":
            dot_color_name = layer.get("dot_color", "graphite")
            dot_color = _color(dot_color_name)
            angle = INK_ANGLES.get(dot_color_name, 45)
            pitch = DOT_SCREENS[dots]
            if pitch <= 2 * DOT_RADIUS:
                raise BenDayError("dot screen spacing too small for radius")
            anchor = layer.get("anchor", "object")
            if anchor not in ("object", "screen"):
                raise BenDayError("anchor must be 'object' or 'screen'")
            shift_x = register_x - (tx if anchor == "screen" else 0)
            shift_y = register_y - (ty if anchor == "screen" else 0)
            pid = f"dots-{ident}"
            defs.append(f'<pattern id="{pid}" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" '
                        f'width="{pitch:g}" height="{pitch:g}" '
                        f'patternTransform="translate({shift_x:g} {shift_y:g}) rotate({angle})">'
                        f'<circle cx="{pitch/2:g}" cy="{pitch/2:g}" r="{DOT_RADIUS:g}" '
                        f'fill="{dot_color}"/></pattern>')
            body.append(f'<{tag} {geom} fill="url(#{pid})"/>')
        if float(outline) > 0:
            body.append(f'<{tag} {geom} fill="none" stroke="{ink}" '
                        f'stroke-width="{outline}" stroke-linejoin="round"/>')
        art.append(f'<g id="{ident}" transform="{trans}" opacity="{opacity}">'
                   + "".join(body) + "</g>")

    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" '
            f'viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" data-frame="{frame}">'
            f'<defs>{"".join(defs)}</defs><rect width="{width}" height="{height}" '
            f'fill="{paper}"/>{"".join(art)}{"".join(text_art)}</svg>')
"""Behavioral acceptance tests for the Nerd Court Ben-Day print renderer."""
import re
import unittest
from xml.etree import ElementTree

from ben_day import BenDayError, render_svg, PALETTE


BASE = {"width": 320, "height": 180, "layers": [
    {"id": "court-wall", "type": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 320, "height": 180,
     "fill": "violet", "dot_color": "magenta", "dots": "medium"},
    {"id": "test-actor", "type": "circle", "cx": 74, "cy": 78, "r": 32,
     "fill": "cyan", "dots": "dense", "anchor": "object", "translate": [15, 0]},
    {"id": "caption", "type": "text", "x": 24, "y": 152, "text": "CANON IS LAW", "fill": "paper"},
]}


class BenDayRendererTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_all_shapes_receive_individual_clipped_print_screens(self):
        svg = render_svg(BASE)
        root = ElementTree.fromstring(svg)
        ns = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
        patterns = root.findall(".//" + ns + "pattern")
        self.assertEqual(len(patterns), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(root.findall(".//" + ns + "circle")), 5)
        self.assertIn('fill="url(#dots-court-wall)"', svg)
        self.assertIn('fill="url(#dots-test-actor)"', svg)
        self.assertNotIn('dots-caption', svg)

    def test_dot_radius_stays_constant_when_dot_density_changes(self):
        svg = render_svg(BASE)
        ns = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
        pats = ElementTree.fromstring(svg).findall(".//" + ns + "pattern")
        self.assertNotEqual(pats[0].attrib["width"], pats[1].attrib["width"])
        self.assertEqual(pats[0].find(ns + "circle").attrib["r"],
                         pats[1].find(ns + "circle").attrib["r"])

    def test_dots_cover_shapes_even_when_density_is_omitted(self):
        scene = {"width": 200, "height": 100,
                 "layers": [{"id": "wall", "type": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0,
                             "width": 200, "height": 100, "fill": "violet"}]}
        self.assertIn('id="dots-wall"', render_svg(scene))

    def test_actor_local_screen_moves_with_actor_and_camera_screen_does_not(self):
        scene = {"width": 200, "height": 100, "layers": [
            {"id": "actor", "type": "circle", "cx": 50, "cy": 50, "r": 24,
             "translate": [10, 5], "anchor": "object", "fill": "cyan"},
            {"id": "background", "type": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 80, "height": 80,
             "translate": [10, 5], "anchor": "screen", "fill": "violet"},
        ]}
        svg = render_svg(scene)
        ns = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
        pats = ElementTree.fromstring(svg).findall(".//" + ns + "pattern")
        self.assertIn("translate(0 0)", pats[0].attrib["patternTransform"])
        self.assertIn("translate(-10 -5)", pats[1].attrib["patternTransform"])

    def test_identical_inputs_render_to_identical_svg(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_svg(BASE, frame=17), render_svg(BASE, frame=17))

    def test_text_is_escaped_and_remains_undotted(self):
        scene = {"width": 220, "height": 90, "layers": [
            {"id": "caption", "type": "text", "x": 20, "y": 60,
             "text": '"DOOM" <TONY> & co.', "fill": "paper"},
        ]}
        svg = render_svg(scene)
        ElementTree.fromstring(svg)
        self.assertIn('&lt;TONY&gt; &amp; co.', svg)
        self.assertNotIn('<TONY>', svg)
        self.assertNotIn('<pattern', svg)

    def test_rejects_invalid_svg_injection_and_style_values(self):
        cases = [
            {"id": "a", "type": "path", "d": 'M 0 0 L 1 1" onload="evil()"', "fill": "cyan"},
            {"id": "bad space", "type": "rect", "x": 1, "y": 1, "width": 2, "height": 2},
            {"id": "valid", "type": "rect", "x": 1, "y": 1, "width": 2, "height": 2, "fill": "url(http://evil)"},
            {"id": "valid", "type": "circle", "cx": 10, "cy": 10, "r": 4, "dots": "fuzzy"},
        ]
        for entry in cases:
            with self.subTest(entry=entry):
                with self.assertRaises(BenDayError):
                    render_svg({"width": 120, "height": 90, "layers": [entry]})

    def test_rejects_duplicate_ids_invalid_coordinates_and_frame(self):
        sc = {"width": 150, "height": 90, "layers": [
            {"id": "z", "type": "circle", "cx": 10, "cy": 10, "r": 4},
            {"id": "z", "type": "circle", "cx": 30, "cy": 30, "r": 4},
        ]}
        with self.assertRaises(BenDayError):
            render_svg(sc)
        with self.assertRaises(BenDayError):
            render_svg({"width": -1, "height": 90, "layers": []})
        with self.assertRaises(BenDayError):
            render_svg(BASE, frame=-1)

    def test_palette_consistent_for_all_frames(self):
        svg = render_svg(BASE, frame=90)
        for color in (PALETTE["violet"], PALETTE["magenta"], PALETTE["cyan"]):
            self.assertIn(color, svg)
        self.assertEqual(9, len(PALETTE))

    def test_independent_registrations_are_deterministic(self):
        scene = {"width": 200, "height": 120,
                 "registration": [2, -1],
                 "layers": [{"id": "a", "type": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0,
                             "width": 180, "height": 100, "fill": "cyan"}]}
        svg = render_svg(scene)
        self.assertIn("translate(2 -1)", svg)
        self.assertEqual(svg, render_svg(scene))

    def test_svg_can_rasterize_to_a_real_image(self):
        try:
            import cairosvg
            from PIL import Image
            from io import BytesIO
        except ImportError:
            self.skipTest("Optional raster proof requires cairosvg and Pillow")
        raster = cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=render_svg(BASE).encode("utf-8"))
        im = Image.open(BytesIO(raster)).convert("RGB")
        self.assertEqual(im.size, (320, 180))
        self.assertNotEqual(im.getpixel((74, 78)), im.getpixel((8, 8)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Build an original Ben-Day courtroom style proof as a real H.264/AAC MP4.

This is a renderer smoke test, NOT a Nerd Court episode or UATU integration.
The figures and sounds are original anonymous geometric constructions.
Requires CairoSVG, ffmpeg and ffprobe for local demonstration.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import io
import math
import os
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import wave
from pathlib import Path

from ben_day import render_svg

W, H = 960, 540
FPS = 15
DURATION = 5


def box(id, x, y, width, height, fill, dots="medium", **kw):
    return {"id": id, "type": "rect", "x": x, "y": y, "width": width,
            "height": height, "fill": fill, "dots": dots, **kw}


def poly(id, points, fill, dots="medium", **kw):
    return {"id": id, "type": "polygon", "points": points, "fill": fill, "dots": dots, **kw}


def oval(id, cx, cy, rx, ry, fill, dots="medium", **kw):
    return {"id": id, "type": "ellipse", "cx": cx, "cy": cy, "rx": rx, "ry": ry,
            "fill": fill, "dots": dots, **kw}


def label(id, x, y, text, size=24, fill="paper", **kw):
    return {"id": id, "type": "text", "x": x, "y": y, "text": text,
            "font_size": size, "fill": fill, **kw}


def frame_scene(frame: int, fps: int = FPS) -> dict:
    t = frame / fps
    impact = 3.2 <= t < 4.25
    flick = -3 if impact and frame % 2 == 0 else 3 if impact else 0
    left_shift = -24 * max(0, 1 - t / 0.8)
    right_shift = 24 * max(0, 1 - t / 0.8)
    pitch_shift = -4 if impact and frame % 3 == 0 else 0
    s = {"width": W, "height": H, "registration": [pitch_shift, 0], "layers": []}
    a = s["layers"]
    # Printed graphic novel staging: every architectural surface gets a tint screen.
    a.extend([
        box("stage-wall", 0, 0, W, H, "graphite", "dense", dot_color="slate", stroke_width=0),
        poly("manga-left", [(0, 0), (480, 0), (180, 540), (0, 540)], "violet", "dense", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=0),
        poly("manga-right", [(710, 0), (W, 0), (W, H), (505, H)], "crimson", "medium", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=0),
        poly("window", [(290, 95), (670, 95), (740, 290), (215, 290)], "slate", "open", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=8),
        box("court-ribbon", 25, 26, 910, 82, "paper", "open", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=7),
        box("court-ribbon-rule", 30, 108, 900, 7, "graphite", "none", stroke_width=0),
        poly("floor-perspective", [(0, 433), (W, 433), (W, H), (0, H)], "violet", "dense", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=0),
    ])
    # Establish cast silhouettes with independent texture anchoring.
    a.extend([
        poly("prosecutor-shoulders", [(48, 445), (91, 318), (183, 318), (234, 445)], "crimson", "medium", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=7, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        oval("prosecutor-head", 139, 292, 53, 64, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        poly("prosecutor-hair", [(88, 290), (85, 264), (118, 223), (162, 231), (188, 267), (180, 283), (160, 249), (135, 266), (115, 250)], "graphite", "dense", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=2, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        box("prosecutor-tie", 130, 350, 15, 77, "magenta", "dense", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=2, translate=[left_shift, 0]),
        poly("defense-jacket", [(718, 445), (750, 314), (851, 314), (918, 445)], "cyan", "dense", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=7, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        oval("defense-head", 805, 290, 52, 65, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        poly("defense-hair", [(754, 271), (763, 224), (827, 221), (857, 269), (840, 245), (801, 239), (785, 255)], "graphite", "medium", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=2, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        box("defense-glasses-left", 760, 279, 38, 17, "graphite", "none", stroke_width=3, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        box("defense-glasses-right", 808, 279, 39, 17, "graphite", "none", stroke_width=3, translate=[right_shift, 0]),
        # Judge center and desk: distinct inks and dot density, not a full-frame filter.
        poly("judge-body", [(380, 420), (408, 267), (538, 267), (584, 420)], "graphite", "medium", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=8),
        oval("judge-head", 475, 256, 63, 72, "amber", "open", dot_color="crimson", stroke_width=6),
        poly("judge-hair", [(415, 236), (421, 186), (450, 175), (483, 182), (518, 178), (534, 215), (524, 223), (496, 203), (468, 205), (451, 199)], "paper", "dense", dot_color="amber", stroke_width=4),
        box("bench-front", 285, 390, 388, 90, "violet", "dense", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=8),
        poly("bench-trim", [(284, 392), (674, 392), (688, 405), (275, 405)], "yellow", "open", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=4),
        oval("bench-seal", 479, 444, 36, 27, "yellow", "medium", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=4),
        label("bench-mark", 461, 452, "NC", 20, "graphite"),
    ])
    # Caption tape and labels stay on top with undithered typography.
    a.extend([
        box("subtitle-strip", 32, 485, 896, 41, "paper", "open", dot_color="yellow", stroke_width=4),
        label("top-title", 65, 89, "NERD COURT", 63, "graphite"),
        label("top-kicker", 625, 90, "CANON IS LAW", 26, "violet"),
        label("bottom-name", 58, 515, "WHERE ONLY CANON IS LAW", 26, "graphite"),
    ])
    if 0.75 <= t < 3.15:
        line = "THE EVIDENCE SPEAKS." if t < 2.1 else "OBJECTION, YOUR HONOR!"
        a.extend([
            poly("speech-balloon", [(210, 167), (755, 167), (755, 222), (522, 222), (485, 246), (466, 222), (210, 222)],
                 "paper", "open", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=6),
            label("speech-text", 238, 205, line, 31, "graphite"),
        ])
    if impact:
        # A print-registration tear and aggressive dot burst instead of generic shake.
        a.extend([
            poly("impact-wedge", [(330 + flick, 134), (623 + flick, 134), (711 + flick, 260),
                                  (637 + flick, 351), (296 + flick, 351), (246 + flick, 252)],
                 "yellow", "impact", dot_color="magenta", stroke_width=12),
            label("impact-word", 315 + flick, 278, "OBJECTION!", 58, "graphite"),
            poly("impact-speed-one", [(0, 188), (232, 241), (0, 216)], "paper", "dense", dot_color="cyan", stroke_width=0),
            poly("impact-speed-two", [(W, 221), (720, 251), (W, 255)], "cyan", "impact", dot_color="graphite", stroke_width=0),
        ])
    return s


def synthesize_audio(path: Path, seconds: int) -> None:
    """Original simple mechanical gavel stings; no samples or music licenses."""
    rate = 22050
    pulses = (0.65, 2.13, 3.25, 4.2)
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as f:
        f.setnchannels(1)
        f.setsampwidth(2)
        f.setframerate(rate)
        block = bytearray()
        for i in range(seconds * rate):
            t = i / rate
            value = 0.0
            for at in pulses:
                dt = t - at
                if 0 <= dt < .27:
                    value += (math.sin(2 * math.pi * (128 + 45 * dt) * dt)
                              + .30 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 370 * dt)) * math.exp(-dt * 24)
            block.extend(struct.pack("<h", max(-32767, min(32767, int(value * 12500)))))
        f.writeframes(block)


def create_demo(out_dir: Path, *, seconds: int = DURATION, fps: int = FPS) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    try:
        import cairosvg
    except ImportError as err:
        raise RuntimeError("Demo needs CairoSVG: pip install cairosvg") from err
    if not shutil.which("ffmpeg"):
        raise RuntimeError("Demo needs ffmpeg in PATH")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frame_count = seconds * fps
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nerd-court-ben-day-") as scratch:
        scratch_dir = Path(scratch)
        for i in range(frame_count):
            svg = render_svg(frame_scene(i, fps), frame=i)
            cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=svg.encode("utf-8"),
                             write_to=str(scratch_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png"))
            if i in (0, int(1.2 * fps), int(3.5 * fps)):
                (out_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.svg").write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
                shutil.copy(scratch_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png", out_dir / f"frame_{i:04d}.png")
        wav = scratch_dir / "original-stings.wav"
        synthesize_audio(wav, seconds)
        video = out_dir / "nerd-court-benday-proof.mp4"
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
               "-framerate", str(fps), "-i", str(scratch_dir / "frame_%04d.png"),
               "-i", str(wav), "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "18", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
               "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k", "-movflags", "+faststart",
               "-t", str(seconds), str(video)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    return video, out_dir / f"frame_{int(3.5 * fps):04d}.png"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/mnt/data/ben_day_proof", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--seconds", default=DURATION, type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--fps", default=FPS, type=int)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.seconds <= 15 or not 5 <= args.fps <= 30:
        ap.error("demo accepts 1–15 seconds and 5–30 fps")
    video, frame = create_demo(args.out, seconds=args.seconds, fps=args.fps)
    print(f"Rendered video {video} and preview {frame}")
